title: How to Build a Real Estate App With AI (No Coding Required)
summary: Build a property listing app with search, filters, agent profiles, and contact forms — without writing code. Step-by-step guide using AI in 2026.
body_markdown: Direct MLS integration requires an MLS data feed agreement and typically developer work for the API. For most independent agents and small brokerages, a manual import workflow works well: export listings from your MLS, import to Blink. Start there; add MLS integration later if volume justifies it.
